Hi Lydia —

Great speaking with you yesterday. As discussed, we’re happy to offer NovaPay a Private VPC pilot evaluation grant (6,000 compute credits) to validate the end-to-end integration in a dedicated environment. To move forward we need the standard security evidence for security gating on Private deployments.

Attached: security-evidence-checklist.xlsx and pilot-credits-terms.pdf — the checklist is high-level and maps directly to the gating items our infra team requires to provision isolated nodes. Key asks:
- SOC 2 Type II attestation (or equivalent)
- Network diagram showing VPC peering / egress controls
- High-level data flow (what data touches Redwood runtime vs stays in your network)
- Encryption-at-rest and in-transit statements + KMS approach
- Contact for technical security review (CISO or security engineering)

If you can share the checklist items you have today, we’ll review and confirm what’s sufficient to provision the pilot. Once security gives a thumbs-up, I’ll open the grant in HubSpot and route a short approval to our revenue ops team (usually 48–72 hours).

Proposed kickoff window: Sep 13–17 (we’ll reserve a 2-hour onboarding slot for the private VPC prep).

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live for you.

Best,

Data flow (high-level):

- PVs in Redwood handle tokenization and model inference; no persistent storage of raw PII in Redwood.
